failure_evidence: The first type-check with TypeScript 7.0.2 failed because vue-tsc 3.3.12 needs typescript/lib/tsc. TypeScript 6.0.3 passed. An initial preview-hash check attempted a Blob fetch blocked by CSP; the final checker reads the already-created Blob directly without weakening the policy.
scope: Synthetic browser fixtures, ordinary PDF and PNG output. No core, engine, package API or npm release change. WebKit is not branded Safari certification.
